name: Hell Creek Formation
description: One of the most famous fossil sites in the world, where the first well-preserved T-Rex was found.

name: Flaming Cliffs
description: Where the first dinosaur eggs were discovered in 1923, changing our understanding of dinosaur reproduction.

name: Patagonia
description: Home to the largest dinosaurs ever discovered, including the massive Argentinosaurus.

name: Dinosaur Provincial Park
description: UNESCO World Heritage Site with over 40 dinosaur species found — one of the richest fossil beds on Earth!

name: Solnhofen Limestone
description: Where the first Archaeopteryx was found — the missing link between dinosaurs and birds!

name: Lyme Regis
description: Mary Anning's legendary fossil hunting grounds, where she discovered complete marine reptile skeletons as a teenager!

name: Morrison Formation
description: The site of the great 'Bone Wars' between rival paleontologists Cope and Marsh in the 1870s!

name: Liaoning Province
description: Revolutionary feathered dinosaur fossils found here proved the dinosaur-bird connection beyond doubt!

name: Tendaguru
description: Africa's richest dinosaur fossil site, where the massive Giraffatitan skeleton was excavated.

name: Ischigualasto
description: Known as 'Valley of the Moon' — home to some of the oldest dinosaurs ever found, from the very dawn of the age of dinosaurs!

name: Narmada Valley
description: India's dinosaur country! The fierce Rajasaurus — 'King Lizard' — was discovered here, a uniquely Indian predator.

name: Ariyalur
description: A treasure trove of fossils in Southern India — the Bruhathkayosaurus found here may have been one of the largest dinosaurs ever!
